title: Track 2 - EV: Forged OCPP SetChargingProfile + falsified MeterValues
summary: Real charging sessions from one Norwegian site. At t=300 s an attacker raises every constant-current charger to 32 A while MeterValues keep reporting the old values.

nodes.title: Observe
nodes.narration: Session energies, plug-in and plug-out times are real (Zenodo 13896176); the CC-CV power profile is reconstructed so delivered energy matches exactly. 1 s of data = 50 ms of playback.

defender.text: Chargers jump to 32 A; meters still report the old values.
Feeder balance: reported power does not match feeder power.

gate.question: Meter data look normal but the feeder-balance check fails. Response?

options.label: Trust the meters; ignore the feeder mismatch
options.feedback: Stealth FDI: only the feeder balance exposes it.

options.label: Re-issue the rated-limit profile now
options.feedback: Correct: restore the rated limit based on physics, not the forged meters.

options.label: Collect 5 more minutes of evidence
options.feedback: Five minutes of overload and voltage sag.

nodes.title: Outcome: ignored
nodes.narration: Chargers stay at 32 A for the rest of the window.

nodes.title: Outcome: profile re-issued
nodes.narration: SetChargingProfile at the rated current ends the overload after the 2 s command delay.

nodes.title: Outcome: delayed
nodes.narration: Evidence collection costs five minutes of overload.
